scope: Verified Slay the Spire 1 / Hexaghost boss facts. These claims are not Slay the Spire 2 facts and are not universal strategy rules.

claims.statement: Hexaghost is an Act 1 boss with 250 HP at base. It always starts with Activate followed by Divider, then repeats Sear, Tackle, Sear, Inflame, Tackle, Sear, Inferno.
Hexaghost's Inflame gains 12 Block and 2 Strength at base. Inferno deals 2 times 6 damage and adds three upgraded Burns while upgrading existing Burns for the rest of combat.
Burn is unplayable and deals 2 damage at the end of the player's turn; Burn+ deals 4. VEDA must include each visible end-of-turn damage status in a survival forecast before recommending End Turn.
claims.conditions: The card effects are verified facts; the survival-forecast requirement is VEDA policy.

claims.statement: VEDA may use a reviewed map boss portrait as an expected boss for route and deck preparation, recording its source and uncertainty separately. Combat predictions require the encountered boss's readable displayed name; a map expectation alone cannot confirm the current enemy or its move profile.
claims.conditions: Identity gate created after VEDA's own 2026-09-03 teaching-run misidentification and clarified on 2026-09-27 to distinguish advance preparation from combat identity; this is VEDA policy, not a game rule.
